notes: IQC 0.5.0 - your programs: MY PC sorts every installed program (read-only), measures the space they could give back, shrinks one program at a time with Windows' own lossless compression (undo any time), and runs a copy in a box - even a desktop program with its window. Also new: the strong wall, Ibis with her own memory, her coder, and web search through your own engine. The licence changed: a new section, YOUR PROGRAMS, and the other connections IQC makes (only when you ask) - please read it in the installer.
